title: Ringo Starr has dinner with Paul and Linda McCartney | 1970
content:
Ringo Starr and Maureen Starkey had dinner with Paul and Linda McCartney on 22 January 1970.

The dinner party took place at 7 Cavendish Avenue, the McCartneys’ London home.

During the evening, Paul told Ringo about his forthcoming album, McCartney, which was being worked on in secret. Starr kept the news to himself, even when asked by the press the following month about McCartney’s plans.
